Capcom's reputation for delivering a regular schedule of high quality games based on proprietary tech continues with the arrival of Onimusha: Way of the Sword. In this video, John puts the new game into the context of its predecessors, appreciates the new take on the series via the RE Engine and stacks up the various console versions - including Switch 2.
